claire_finance: FYI customer QuarkAI flagged a surprise Dedicated overage on INV-2025-1188 for Apr 21. They want explanation and a refund.

diego_billing: Invoice lines: Dedicated commit Apr: $10,000; Burst overage Apr 21: $1,760 (112,000 tokens). No SLA credit applied.

anya_eng: Quick check of placement logs: autoscaler mis-evaluated available reserved slots during a short rollback and briefly routed ~90s of traffic to dedicated GPUs. Root cause: a race in the autoscale lease renewal. Request samples: rq_q1, rq_q2.

claire_finance: If this was our internal rollback error, we should credit. How much do we credit? Full or prorated?

diego_billing: Overage line is $1,760. Propose full credit given it's provider error. I'll prepare adjustment draft but need Finance approval and an incident ID.

anya_eng: Filed INF-3121 with timeline and fix (lease renewal lock). Patch merged. Confirm provider fault.

kevin_cs: I'll draft a customer note offering the credit and brief timeline + prevention steps. QuarkAI wants the credit ASAP.

claire_finance: Approve full credit of $1,760. Use reason code DED-AUTO-SCALE-WARP and reference INF-3121. Also add a short action: billing to flag similar sub-5min placements for review.

diego_billing: Creating adjustment ADJ-9633 for $1,760 credit and ticket. billing-bot: create audit ticket.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-4572 - "ADJ-9633 for INV-2025-1188 (DED-AUTO-SCALE-WARP)". Audit trail started.

claire_finance: Thanks team. Kevin, send the CS note and mark this closed once ADJ posts.

kevin_cs: Will send now and include BIL-4572. :white_check_mark:
